instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Residential renovation and energy retrofit company performing deep energy upgrades including external insulation, heat pump installation, and solar PV integration. Completing ~80 projects per year across major metropolitan areas in the Northeast. Seeking to standardize energy audit workflows with tablet-based inspection and automated grant application filing to improve operational efficiency.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our engineering team adopted an agile methodology last year, moving from waterfall-style quarterly releases to 2-week sprints with continuous deployment. This reduced our release cycle time by 60% and improved cross-functional collaboration. However, adjacent teams (marketing, support) are still adapting to the faster cadence, leading to siloed knowledge gaps that hinder holistic product innovation.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
answers.additionalContext: The supply chain volatility for key materials like insulation and high-efficiency HVAC units creates unpredictable cost pressures. There is a recognized internal desire to break dependency on purely residential retrofitting by exploring B2B commercial energy consulting services.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: Standardized Digital Workflow Implementation (Quick Win)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing the proposed tablet-based inspection and grant application system will immediately improve operational efficiency and reduce errors in project documentation.

first_actions: Select a low-code platform for workflow automation.
Pilot the tablet inspection app on 5 active projects.
Integrate basic data capture with existing CRM.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in project administrative time by 25%
milestones: Week 1: Platform selection and vendor contracting.
Month 2: MVP deployed on pilot projects.
Month 3: Full rollout to all teams.

opportunities.title: Value-Added Material Consultancy Service
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the engineering team's existing knowledge to offer specialized consultation on material selection and optimization for high-efficiency heat pump systems.

first_actions: Define a service package focused on 'optimal insulation stack design'.
Develop sales collateral based on past project data.
Train 2 senior engineers on consultative selling.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in average project margin by 3%
milestones: Month 1: Service package defined and pricing finalized.
Month 4: Secure first three consulting contracts.

opportunities.title: Adjacent B2B Commercial Energy Retrofit Platform (Diversification)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a modular, scalable software platform that allows Catalyst Analytics to move beyond residential work and offer standardized energy consulting services to commercial real estate owners.

first_actions: Conduct market validation interviews with 5 commercial property managers.
Identify core technology stack requirements for B2B data aggregation.
Secure seed funding for a dedicated R&D sprint.
resources_needed: Dedicated product manager salary allocation (requires strategic shift)
execution_plan.success_metric: Securing 2 paying B2B pilot clients within the short term.
milestones: Week 4: Proof of Concept (PoC) for a commercial service module.
Month 6: Beta launch with first commercial client.

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated Innovation Task Force and allocate 5 hours/week for process optimization pilots.
Conduct market gap analysis for B2B commercial energy services to validate radical diversification potential.
Finalize budget and scope for the standardized digital workflow MVP and assign project lead.

key_weaknesses: Inconsistent process definition leading to fragmented innovation efforts.
Limited formal experience in scaling technological solutions beyond internal team needs.
High dependency on key technical talent resulting in burnout and slow development cadence.
Lack of dedicated time or budget ring-fencing for non-core R&D activities.
